summary_en: Specific metrics and targets not disclosed in header. Board resolved to update disclosure on cost-of-capital and share-price-conscious management. Full details in attached materials.
title_en: Measures toward realization of management conscious of cost of capital and share price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, Stella Chemifa Corporation's board of directors resolved to update its disclosure on measures toward realizing management conscious of cost of capital and share price. The company states that the update reflects current analysis, evaluation, and progress on existing initiatives. The specific metrics, targets, and any revisions to prior cost-of-capital targets are deferred to the attached detailed materials (not reproduced in the header pages provided). This is a routine COC disclosure refresh.
